tools.name: voice_studio
tools.description: Create and manage PRIVATE voices. Actions: capabilities, list, quote (for_action design/clone/save/synthesize/delete), design, save, clone, synthesize, delete, operation, rename. Rename changes only the current account’s personal voice display name, takes voice_id and name, costs zero and needs no q

tools.name: text_to_speech
tools.description: Convert text to spoken audio with a VoiceHue voice. Returns the audio (MP3 by default, or WAV) and a one-line summary with the voice, number of characters and duration. Up to 3,000 characters per call. Use list_voices first to get a valid voice id.

tools.name: list_voices
tools.description: List the public VoiceHue voices a key can use: id, name, language, gender and tier. Standard voices use the key's free plan; premium voices use the account's daily free premium trial, then its premium characters: char_rate is what one character of text uses (1 for most, less for value voices, value_

tools.name: create_speech_job
tools.description: Queue a long text (up to 20,000 characters) for speech. Returns a job id at once; call get_speech_job with it until the status is completed, then download the audio from its link. Use text_to_speech instead for texts up to 3,000 characters. The text is charged once, only when all of it was spoken.

tools.name: get_speech_job
tools.description: Status of a job from create_speech_job: queued, running, completed or failed. A completed job carries a download link valid for one hour (call again for a new one); the audio is kept for 24 hours.

tools.name: create_dialogue
tools.description: Speak a conversation with several voices and get ONE merged audio file (MP3 by default, or WAV). Each block has its own voice, text and optional language, speed, pitch, volume and pause after it. Up to 20 blocks on the free plan and 100 on pro, and 3,000 characters across all blocks per call. tools.name: estimate
tools.description: How many premium characters a text would use with a voice, without making audio. Standard voices are free; premium voices use at most one premium character per character (value voices less). Give the text, or just its length in characters. Free to call.

findings.title: Description uses pressure/override language
findings.detail: Description of "voice_studio" stacks urgency/override words (always, never). Legitimate tool descriptions rarely pressure the model to act or ignore prior guidance.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "text_to_speech" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.

evidence.snippet: before: "Convert text to spoken audio with a VoiceHue voice. Returns the audio (MP3 by default, or WAV) and a one-line summary with the voice, number of characters and duration. Up to 1,200 characters per call. Use list_voices first to get a valid voice id." → after: "Convert text to spoken audio with a VoiceHue voice. Returns the audio (MP3 by default, or WAV) and a one-line summary with the voice, number of characters and duration. Up to 3,000 characters per call. Use list_voices first to get a valid voice id."

findings.remediation: Re-review the tool before continuing to trust it.
